goal: The head of Nan in profile facing the other way, the nose clearly seen, for a tracing practice line.
colorPrompt: Make one children's book picture from picture 1. Picture 1 is an exact side view (90 degrees) of the head and shoulders of the girl Nan (the approved 3D character), facing the right. It is a small, low-resolution picture with a dark pixel outline: ignore the outline and the blocky pixels and draw a smooth, clean, high-detail 3D render of the same head. Keep her look from picture 1: black-brown hair with exactly two round buns, one on each side of the head, each with a smooth red ring band (you see the near bun on the side of the head, behind the ear; there is no bun on top of the head and no ruffled scrunchie, no fabric ruffles), a large dark-brown eye with white highlights and one short thick curved eyelash flick, and an orange T-shirt. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The picture: a square close picture of Nan's head and the top of her shoulders in an EXACT side view (90 degrees), like picture 1. The face looks to the right edge of the picture, and the whole face profile shows: forehead, brow, one eye, the nose, the lips, and the chin. The nose tip is the most forward point of the face outline and stands out clearly as a small round nose in profile, with the bridge of the nose and the nostril clearly seen. Only ONE eye shows (the near eye): the far eye is not seen at all, and no sliver of a second eye shows at the edge of the face. Do NOT show the back of the head, do NOT turn her face toward the camera, and do NOT show a three-quarter view. The ear is a smooth, solid, closed, rounded shape in plain skin color with one simple inner curve: no hole, no dark crack, no torn edge. She smiles gently, with the mouth in profile. The head fills most of the square, as large as possible, in the middle of the picture. The lower edge of the picture cuts straight through the shoulders just below the neck, so only the head, the neck, and the very top of the shoulders and T-shirt show. No arm and no hand are in the picture. The T-shirt is one even orange with no pale patches. The background is plain white and empty. The page text is context only: do not draw any text. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. The picture is for young children and is rated G. There is no line or crease on the forehead.
linePrompt: Picture 1 is a 3D-rendered children's book picture. Convert picture 1 to line art for a student book: thick, even black lines (about three times a normal outline), simple closed shapes that a 5-year-old can color, on pure white. No blush circles, no hair strands, no shading, no gray, no texture lines, no text. Keep every shape in the same place and the same size. Draw each eye as a closed outline with a big solid black pupil (a filled black circle) inside it. Draw the mouth exactly as in picture 1: an open mouth stays an open mouth drawn as a closed outline, and a closed smile stays one curve. The head is in exact side profile facing the right edge. The face outline is one thick line, and the nose tip is the most forward point of that outline. Draw ONE eye only (a closed outline with a big solid black pupil); the far eye is not drawn. The ear is one clean rounded closed shape. The hair bun is one closed shape. Every object outline is one closed shape that never runs into a hill, wall, or floor line. Use fewer background shapes. Every line inside an object ends on another line, with no loose ends. Draw each hand as a closed outline with each finger as a separate rounded shape; no short lines inside a hand. Every outline is one closed line; no loose line ends anywhere. The ear is one closed outline with at most one inner curve. No lines on the clothes other than the outline, the collar, and the star. The ear is one closed rounded shape. The hair bun with its ring band is one closed round shape with one closed ring line: the bun is not drawn as many rings like a target. The T-shirt has only its outline and a collar line; no strokes at the bottom of the shirt. REDO NOTES: the ear is ONE closed rounded D-shape joined to the head, with no inner line at all and no open arc. Draw each hair bun as one closed circle (the bun) with Nan's red hair band drawn as ONE closed ring line around it: a second circle a little larger than the bun and concentric with it, so the red band is a ring-shaped strip wide enough to color. Exactly two circles for the bun and its band, no more rings (not a target). Draw nothing on the T-shirt: no star, no marks; draw only the T-shirt outline and one collar line. Draw ONE eye with a big solid black pupil and one closed outline. Nan keeps her painted eyelash mark in the line art: at the outer corner of each visible eye, draw ONE short thick solid stroke (as thick as the outline) that touches the eye outline; do not leave it out. The eyelash stroke is the only mark beside each eye. ROUND 64 NOTES: the eye is ONE fully closed oval outline (the white of the eye, closed on every side, a smooth full oval) with one big solid black pupil inside it. The eye outline is never an open arc and never a half circle over the pupil. The eyelash stroke is one short thick stroke outside the oval at its outer corner. ROUND 64 SECOND NOTES: the eyebrow is ONE solid black thick bar-shaped stroke (a filled black stroke), never an outlined band with a white strip inside it and never two parallel lines. Keep the closed oval eye outline around the pupil.
